title: Affine depth-two hull of the actual finite etale pushforward
statement:
theorem affine_depth_two_pushforward_hull
    {L : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian L] (U : L.Opens)
    (hboundary : ∀ y : L, y ∉ U →
      (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := L.presheaf.stalk y) (L.presheaf.stalk y))
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ U.toScheme) [IsFinite f] [Etale f]
    (V : L.Opens) (hV : IsAffineOpen V) :
    let g := f ≫ U.ι
    let B : L.CommAlgebraSheaf := Under.mk
      (⟨g.c⟩ : L.sheaf ⟶ (TopCat.Sheaf.pushforward CommRingCat.{u} g.base).obj X.sheaf)
    let N := Modules.restrict B.toModule hV.fromSpec
    N.IsQuasicoherent ∧
      Module.Finite (L.presheaf.obj (op V)) Γ(N, ⊤) ∧
      (∀ x : Spec (L.presheaf.obj (op V)), hV.fromSpec x ∉ U →
        ∃ hfinite : Module.Finite ((Spec (L.presheaf.obj (op V))).presheaf.stalk x)
            (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u}) N.val.presheaf x),
          letI := hfinite
          (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth
            (R := (Spec (L.presheaf.obj (op V))).presheaf.stalk x)
            (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u}) N.val.presheaf x))

proof.text: Write A=Gamma(L,V), j=hV.fromSpec, W=j inverse-image U, t=j restricted to U, and P=f_*O_X. Apply [lem-pc-finite-flat-pushforward-locally-free] to P; pullback along t and the restriction/pullback isomorphism show P restricted along t is finite locally free. Transport the boundary depth of the base across the open-immersion stalk ring equivalence, using the private depth_eq_of_semilinear_equiv equality, which transports regular sequences and maximal ideals in both directions.
Apply [lem-sbc-affine-depth-two-locally-free-model] to obtain H with coherent affine sections and depth-two boundary stalks, and its restriction isomorphism with P restricted along t.

Apply [lem-sbc-open-restriction-pushforward-comparison] and composition of pushforwards to identify N with the W-direct image of P restricted along t. Apply [lem-sbc-open-base-change-structure-module] to identify N with C.toModule, where C is the algebra of the base-changed cover fprime followed by W inclusion. The restriction/pushforward counit and these isomorphisms identify H restricted to W with C.toModule restricted to W.

Apply [lem-sbc-depth-two-hartogs-algebra-comparison] on Spec A to the base-changed cover and H, giving H isomorphic to C.toModule and hence N. Transport quasi-coherence using its isomorphism-closed object property. Apply the affine global-section functor to obtain an A-linear equivalence, transporting finite generation. Apply [def-pc-module-stalk-functor] to obtain stalk linear equivalences, transporting finite generation and depth; the same private depth_eq_of_semilinear_equiv equality applies with the identity ring equivalence and the stalk linear equivalence, so no separate same-ring depth proof is required. This proves every clause with the original scalar actions and without altering the target statement.
